theorem mvcc.stateAfter_append (log : mvcc.Log) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.stateAfter (log ++
    [cs]) = mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑(List.length log)) (mvcc.stateAfter log) cs

theorem mvcc.KvMatch_none_left {log : mvcc.Log} {kvo : Option EtcdKv} (h : mvcc.KvMatch log none
    kvo) : kvo = none

theorem mvcc.keyLink_of_rev (k : GoString) (rl : List (List mvcc.Change)) : rl.length < 2 ^ 63 → (∀
    (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ rl → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) → mvcc.LogWf' rl.reverse → mvcc.KeyLink
    rl.reverse k (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf rl.reverse) k)

theorem mvcc.kiFold_nil (ki0 : mvcc.KeyIndex) (k : GoString) : mvcc.kiFold ki0 [] k = ki0

theorem mvcc.kiOfKey_eq_kiFold (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) : mvcc.kiOfKey evs k =
    mvcc.kiFold mvcc.kiEmpty evs k

def mvcc.ChPutsLe (n : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k v : GoString) (l : w64), mvcc.Change.put k v l ∈ cs → List.length k ≤ n ∧ List.length v ≤ n

theorem mvcc.rev_step (log : mvcc.Log) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (hlen : List.length log + 1 < 2 ^ 63)
    (hcs : cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs])) (k : GoString) (ki0 :
    mvcc.KeyIndex) (h0 : mvcc.KeyLink log k ki0) (i : Nat) : i ≤ cs.length → mvcc.KiWf (mvcc.kiFold
    ki0 (mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i cs)) k) ∧ (∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), r ∈ mvcc.kiRevs
    (mvcc.kiFold ki0 (mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i cs)) k) → BitVec.toNat r.main ≤
    List.length log) ∧ (∀ (r : Nat), r < List.length log → mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiFold ki0
    (mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i cs)) k) (W64 ↑r) = mvcc.kiGet ki0 (W64 ↑r)) ∧ ∀ (r
    : Nat), List.length log ≤ r → r < 2 ^ 63 → mvcc.KvMatch (log ++ [cs]) (mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiFold
    ki0 (mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i cs)) k) (W64 ↑r)) (mvcc.findKey k
    (mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑(List.length log)) (mvcc.stateAfter log) (List.take i cs)))

def mvcc.kiApply (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (ev : mvcc.Ev) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  if ev.tomb = true then if mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki = true then ki else mvcc.kiTombstone ki ev.rev else mvcc.kiPut ki ev.rev

theorem mvcc.stateAt_sorted (log : mvcc.Log) (r : Nat) : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess (mvcc.stateAt log
    r)

theorem mvcc.KvMatch_append {log : mvcc.Log} {o : Option (mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64)} {kvo : Option
    EtcdKv} (h : mvcc.KvMatch log o kvo) (hlt : ∀ (rev : mvcc.Rev) (created ver : w64), o = some
    (rev, created, ver) → BitVec.toNat rev.main < List.length log) (cs : List mvcc.Change) :
    mvcc.KvMatch (log ++ [cs]) o kvo

theorem mvcc.idxLess_swo : StrictWeakOrder mvcc.idxLess

theorem mvcc.idxGet_btInsert {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx) (k' :
    GoString) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (k : GoString) : mvcc.idxGet (btInsert mvcc.idxLess (k', ki) idx)
    k = if k' = k then some ki else mvcc.idxGet idx k

theorem mvcc.kiGet_mem {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} {r : w64} {rev : mvcc.Rev} {created ver : w64} (h :
    mvcc.kiGet ki r = some (rev, created, ver)) : rev ∈ mvcc.kiRevs ki

theorem mvcc.kiFold_append (ki0 : mvcc.KeyIndex) (evs evs' : List mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) :
    mvcc.kiFold ki0 (evs ++ evs') k = mvcc.kiFold (mvcc.kiFold ki0 evs k) evs' k

theorem mvcc.idxPut_eq (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (k : GoString) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.idxPut idx k rev =
    btInsert mvcc.idxLess (k, mvcc.kiPut ((mvcc.idxGet idx k).getD mvcc.kiEmpty) rev) idx

theorem mvcc.LogPutsLe.prefix {n : Nat} {l L : mvcc.Log} (hp : l <+: L) (h : mvcc.LogPutsLe n L) :
    mvcc.LogPutsLe n l

theorem mvcc.idxGet_indexOf_bind (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) (r : w64) : ((mvcc.idxGet
    (mvcc.indexOf evs) k).bind fun ki => mvcc.kiGet ki r) = mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k) r

theorem mvcc.kiOfKey_nil (k : GoString) : mvcc.kiOfKey [] k = mvcc.kiEmpty

theorem mvcc.IdxRep.foldl (evs pre : List mvcc.Ev) (idx : mvcc.IndexM) : mvcc.IdxRep pre idx →
    mvcc.IdxRep (pre ++ evs) (List.foldl mvcc.idxApply idx evs)

theorem mvcc.stateAt_append_ge (log : mvcc.Log) (cs : List mvcc.Change) {r : Nat} (hr : List.length
    log ≤ r) : mvcc.stateAt (log ++ [cs]) r = mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑(List.length log))
    (mvcc.stateAfter log) cs

def mvcc.IdxRep (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (idx : mvcc.IndexM) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx ∧ ∀ (k : GoString), (mvcc.idxGet idx k).getD mvcc.kiEmpty = mvcc.kiOfKey evs k

theorem mvcc.findKey_nil (k : GoString) : mvcc.findKey k [] = none

theorem mvcc.kiOfKey_append (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (ev : mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) : mvcc.kiOfKey (evs
    ++ [ev]) k = if ev.key = k then mvcc.kiApply (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k) ev else mvcc.kiOfKey evs k

theorem mvcc.LogWf'.nil : mvcc.LogWf' []

theorem mvcc.stateAt_ge (log : mvcc.Log) {r : Nat} (hr : List.length log ≤ r) : mvcc.stateAt log r =
    mvcc.stateAfter log

def mvcc.LogWf' (log : mvcc.Log) : Prop :=
  (log ≠ [] → log[0]? = some []) ∧
    ∀ (r : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (i : Nat) (k : GoString),
      log[r]? = some cs →
        cs[i]? = some (mvcc.Change.del k) →
          (mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑r) (mvcc.stateAt log (r - 1)) (List.take i cs))).isSome = true

theorem mvcc.IdxRep.nil : mvcc.IdxRep [] []

theorem mvcc.BucketHas_append {log : mvcc.Log} {rev : mvcc.Rev} {kv : EtcdKv} (h : mvcc.BucketHas
    log rev kv) (hlt : BitVec.toNat rev.main < List.length log) (cs : List mvcc.Change) :
    mvcc.BucketHas (log ++ [cs]) rev kv

theorem mvcc.findKey_filter_ne (k k' : GoString) (s : List EtcdKv) : mvcc.findKey k (List.filter
    (fun x => !decide (x.key = k')) s) = if k' = k then none else mvcc.findKey k s

theorem mvcc.applyChanges_take_succ (r : w64) (s : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < cs.length) : mvcc.applyChanges r s (List.take (i + 1) cs) = mvcc.applyChange r
    (mvcc.applyChanges r s (List.take i cs)) cs[i]

theorem mvcc.stateAt_last (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.stateAt log (List.length log - 1) =
    mvcc.stateAfter log

theorem mvcc.applyChange_sorted {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (r : w64) (c :
    mvcc.Change) : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess (mvcc.applyChange r s c)

theorem mvcc.stateAt_vals {n : Nat} {log : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.LogPutsLe n log) (r : Nat) (v :
    EtcdKv) : v ∈ mvcc.stateAt log r → List.length v.value ≤ n

theorem mvcc.btFind_btInsert_idx (k' : GoString) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (k : GoString) (x :
    mvcc.KeyIndex) (idx : mvcc.IndexM) : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx → btFind mvcc.idxLess (k, x)
    (btInsert mvcc.idxLess (k', ki) idx) = if k' = k then some (k', ki) else btFind mvcc.idxLess (k,
    x) idx

theorem mvcc.idxLess_iff (a b : GoString × mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.idxLess a b ↔ go.GoStringLt a.fst
    b.fst

theorem mvcc.findKey_putKv_self {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (r : w64) (k v :
    GoString) (l : w64) : ∃ nv, mvcc.findKey k (putKv r k v l s) = some nv ∧ nv.key = k ∧ nv.modRev
    = r ∧ nv.createRev = (Option.map EtcdKv.createRev (mvcc.findKey k s)).getD r ∧ nv.version =
    (Option.map EtcdKv.version (mvcc.findKey k s)).getD (W64 0) + W64 1

theorem mvcc.applyChanges_keys {n : Nat} (r : w64) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (hc : mvcc.ChPutsLe n cs)
    (s : List EtcdKv) : (∀ (v : EtcdKv), v ∈ s → List.length v.key ≤ n) → ∀ (v : EtcdKv), v ∈
    mvcc.applyChanges r s cs → List.length v.key ≤ n

theorem mvcc.keyLink_append {log : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (hlen : List.length log + 1 < 2
    ^ 63) (hcs : cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs])) (k : GoString) (h0 :
    mvcc.KeyLink log k (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)) : mvcc.KeyLink (log ++ [cs]) k
    (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf (log ++ [cs])) k)

theorem mvcc.kiGet_top {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) {r : w64} (habove : mvcc.KiAbove ki
    { main := r, sub := W64 0 }) : mvcc.kiGet ki r = if (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs = []
    then none else some ((ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero,
    (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).created, (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).ver)

theorem mvcc.applyChanges_sorted (r : w64) (cs : List mvcc.Change) {s : List EtcdKv} : List.Pairwise
    etcdKvLess s → List.Pairwise etcdKvLess (mvcc.applyChanges r s cs)

theorem mvcc.IdxRep.step {evs : List mvcc.Ev} {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (h : mvcc.IdxRep evs idx) (ev :
    mvcc.Ev) : mvcc.IdxRep (evs ++ [ev]) (mvcc.idxApply idx ev)

def mvcc.BucketHas (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : mvcc.Rev) (kv : EtcdKv) : Prop :=
  ∃ cs,
    log[BitVec.toNat rev.main]? = some cs ∧
      mvcc.changeKv rev.main (mvcc.stateAt log (BitVec.toNat rev.main - 1)) cs (BitVec.toNat rev.sub) = some kv

theorem mvcc.findKey_cons (w : EtcdKv) (ws : List EtcdKv) (k : GoString) : mvcc.findKey k (w :: ws)
    = if w.key = k then some w else mvcc.findKey k ws

theorem mvcc.findKey_putKv_other {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (r : w64) (k k'
    v : GoString) (l : w64) (hne : k' ≠ k) : mvcc.findKey k (putKv r k' v l s) = mvcc.findKey k s

theorem mvcc.LogPutsLe.take {n : Nat} {L : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.LogPutsLe n L) (k : Nat) :
    mvcc.LogPutsLe n (List.take k L)

theorem mvcc.evsOf_append (log : mvcc.Log) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.evsOf (log ++ [cs]) =
    mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) cs

theorem mvcc.keyLink_nil (k : GoString) : mvcc.KeyLink [] k (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf []) k)

def mvcc.KvMatch (log : mvcc.Log) : Option (mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64) → Option EtcdKv → Prop :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | none, none => True
  | some (rev, created, ver), some kv =>
    kv.modRev = rev.main ∧ kv.createRev = created ∧ kv.version = ver ∧ mvcc.BucketHas log rev kv
  | x, x_1 => False

theorem mvcc.LogPutsLe.snoc {n : Nat} {L : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (h : mvcc.LogPutsLe n
    L) (hc : mvcc.ChPutsLe n cs) : mvcc.LogPutsLe n (L ++ [cs])

def mvcc.kiOfKey (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  List.foldl mvcc.kiApply mvcc.kiEmpty (List.filter (fun ev => decide (ev.key = k)) evs)

theorem mvcc.kiFold_singleton (ki0 : mvcc.KeyIndex) (ev : mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) : mvcc.kiFold ki0
    [ev] k = if ev.key = k then mvcc.kiApply ki0 ev else ki0

theorem mvcc.LogPutsLe.empties (n : Nat) : mvcc.LogPutsLe n [[], []]

def mvcc.kiFold (ki0 : mvcc.KeyIndex) (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  List.foldl mvcc.kiApply ki0 (List.filter (fun ev => decide (ev.key = k)) evs)

theorem mvcc.LogWf'.prefix {log : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (h : mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs]))
    : mvcc.LogWf' log

theorem mvcc.genWalk_all_false {revs : List mvcc.Rev} (hne : revs ≠ []) {p : mvcc.Rev → Bool} (h : ∀
    (r : mvcc.Rev), r ∈ revs → p r = false) : mvcc.genWalk revs p = ↑(revs.length - 1)

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_none_of_above {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) {r : w64} (habove
    : mvcc.KiAbove ki { main := r, sub := W64 0 }) (fuel : Nat) : fuel + 1 < ki.gens.length + 1 →
    mvcc.kiFindGenAux ki.gens r fuel = none

theorem mvcc.kiFindGen_top {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) {r : w64} (habove :
    mvcc.KiAbove ki { main := r, sub := W64 0 }) : mvcc.kiFindGen ki r = if (ki.gens.getLastD
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs = [] then none else some (ki.gens.length - 1)

theorem mvcc.evsOfRev_take_succ (m : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) {i : Nat} (hi : i < cs.length) :
    mvcc.evsOfRev m (List.take (i + 1) cs) = mvcc.evsOfRev m (List.take i cs) ++ [{ rev := { main :=
    W64 ↑m, sub := W64 ↑i }, change := cs[i] }]

theorem mvcc.applyChanges_vals {n : Nat} (r : w64) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (hc : mvcc.ChPutsLe n cs)
    (s : List EtcdKv) : (∀ (v : EtcdKv), v ∈ s → List.length v.value ≤ n) → ∀ (v : EtcdKv), v ∈
    mvcc.applyChanges r s cs → List.length v.value ≤ n

theorem mvcc.findKey_btInsert (nv : EtcdKv) (s : List EtcdKv) : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s → ∀ (k :
    GoString), mvcc.findKey k (btInsert etcdKvLess nv s) = if nv.key = k then some nv else
    mvcc.findKey k s

theorem mvcc.stateAt_append_lt (log : mvcc.Log) (cs : List mvcc.Change) {r : Nat} (hr : r <
    List.length log) : mvcc.stateAt (log ++ [cs]) r = mvcc.stateAt log r

theorem mvcc.idxTombstone_eq (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (k : GoString) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.idxTombstone
    idx k rev = if mvcc.kiLastEmpty ((mvcc.idxGet idx k).getD mvcc.kiEmpty) = true then idx else
    btInsert mvcc.idxLess (k, mvcc.kiTombstone ((mvcc.idxGet idx k).getD mvcc.kiEmpty) rev) idx

theorem mvcc.indexOf_rep (evs : List mvcc.Ev) : mvcc.IdxRep evs (mvcc.indexOf evs)

structure mvcc.KeyLink (log : mvcc.Log) (k : GoString) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Prop where
  wf : mvcc.KiWf ki
  revs : BitVec.toNat r.main < List.length log
  match_ : mvcc.KvMatch log (mvcc.kiGet ki (W64 ↑r)) (mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.stateAt log r))

theorem mvcc.stateAfter_sorted (log : mvcc.Log) : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess (mvcc.stateAfter log)

theorem mvcc.kiAbove_of_le {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} {m : Nat} (hm : m < 2 ^ 63) (h : ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), r
    ∈ mvcc.kiRevs ki → BitVec.toNat r.main ≤ m) {r : Nat} (hr : m ≤ r) (hr2 : r < 2 ^ 63) :
    mvcc.KiAbove ki { main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 0 }

theorem mvcc.stateAfter_keys {n : Nat} {log : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.LogPutsLe n log) (v : EtcdKv) : v
    ∈ mvcc.stateAfter log → List.length v.key ≤ n

theorem mvcc.stateAfter_vals {n : Nat} {log : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.LogPutsLe n log) (v : EtcdKv) : v
    ∈ mvcc.stateAfter log → List.length v.value ≤ n

def mvcc.LogPutsLe (n : Nat) (log : mvcc.Log) : Prop :=
  ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → mvcc.ChPutsLe n cs

theorem mvcc.LogPutsLe.mono {n m : Nat} (hnm : n ≤ m) {L : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.LogPutsLe n L) :
    mvcc.LogPutsLe m L

    GoString) (l : w64) : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess (putKv r k v l s)

theorem mvcc.stateAt_keys {n : Nat} {log : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.LogPutsLe n log) (r : Nat) (v :
    EtcdKv) : v ∈ mvcc.stateAt log r → List.length v.key ≤ n

theorem mvcc.KvMatch_none_right {log : mvcc.Log} {o : Option (mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64)} (h :
    mvcc.KvMatch log o none) : o = none

theorem mvcc.kiGet_indexOf (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List
    mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf log) (k : GoString) (r : Nat) (hr
    : r < 2 ^ 63) : mvcc.KvMatch log ((mvcc.idxGet (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log)) k).bind fun ki =>
    mvcc.kiGet ki (W64 ↑r)) (mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.stateAt log r))

theorem mvcc.LogWf'.of_wf {log : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.LogWf log) : mvcc.LogWf' log
